Name: Joyful Toxin
Components: V, S, M (a dose of poison worth at least 100 gp)
Description:
For the spell's duration, you are immune to poison damage and can't be poisoned.

Whenever you would take poison damage, you instead regain hit points equal to half the poison damage you would have taken (rounded down).
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
